instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Independent film and TV production company developing and producing scripted drama series and feature documentaries for streaming platforms and broadcasters. Strato Analytics maintains a slate of 6 projects across various stages, focusing heavily on leveraging advanced data analytics to inform content creation decisions.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer developed an internal dashboard to visualize production order backlogs, which was deemed useful by operations but lacked formal maintenance. This side project highlights a key organizational weakness: the absence of standardized pipelines and institutional support required for innovation to scale beyond informal pilot phases.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.additionalContext: We are 3 months into fundraising conversations with growth equity investors who are conducting deep due diligence on our technology and operations. Their feedback indicates concern about our digital maturity relative to peers. We need to quickly identify and launch 2-3 innovation initiatives that will address these concerns and strengthen our fundraising narrative.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Content Ecosystem (The 'Lock-in' Strategy)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a proprietary AI engine that moves beyond basic recommendation systems to predict long-term audience retention by dynamically tailoring content consumption paths for individual subscribers. This creates deep switching costs, making it extremely difficult for competitors to displace our installed base.

first_actions: Select and acquire a specialized ML/AI firm focused on personalized media experiences.
Pilot the personalization engine on one streaming platform's user segment.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase customer retention rate by 12% within 18 months.
milestones: Q3: Acquire core ML asset and define product roadmap.
Q4: Beta launch of personalization features on Tier 1 platform.

opportunities.title: Generative AI Production Pipeline Automation
opportunities.rationale: Implement a modular generative AI toolset to rapidly prototype and generate high-quality scripts, storyboards, and preliminary VFX assets. This addresses cultural resistance by allowing creative teams to iterate faster and reduces the time-to-greenlight metrics.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated cross-functional AI task force (Creative + Tech).
Integrate one script generation module into the existing content management system.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Hiring of 1 full-time AI workflow specialist
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average production cycle time by 30%.
milestones: Q1: Tool selection and proof-of-concept on one project.
Q2: Full integration of two modular generation tools.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated 'Defense Innovation Fund' budget of €500k specifically for high-risk, market-defense initiatives.
Launch an internal 'Digital Maturity' audit focusing on identifying the top 3 tech gaps that directly influence investor confidence and prepare a narrative response.
Develop formalized, cross-departmental process documentation for 'idea to deployment' (addressing the informal process weakness).

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation process, leading to unmanaged side projects and wasted resources.
Low digital maturity (Level 2), which poses a threat to the narrative required for high-level investor due diligence.
High internal cultural barrier against adopting radical new technologies outside existing business unit comfort zones.
